name: Mistral Search Toolkit
desc: Open-source framework for building production search pipelines
desc_zh: 用于搭建生产级搜索管道的开源框架
solves: Search pipelines are glued together from many parts; Search Toolkit gives composable building blocks that run anywhere.
solves_zh: 搜索管道常由许多零件拼起来，Search Toolkit 提供可组合、随处可跑的构件。
best_for: Your agent keeps missing facts in long PDFs and you need retrieval you can run yourself.
best_for_zh: 智能体总在长 PDF 里漏掉关键事实，需要一套能自己部署的检索。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://mistral.ai/news (official news index)）。 Public preview, open source. Later became the delivery vehicle for Agentic Search inside Mistral Studio and Mistral Vibe. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：官方名字只是「Search Toolkit」，加上厂商名以便辨认。 首次公开日期来源：https://mistral.ai/news/search-toolkit/
